description: Fairy Music v1.0.10: Listen Together Room Sync, Anti-Drift Math & Playback Improvements.

changelog.title: Listen Together Synchronisation Fixes
items: Fixed multi-track desync after ~3 songs: Dynamic radio recommendations and queue updates now append seamlessly without resetting playback
Eliminated sudden 75% track backward seek: Guest now validates remote track IDs before applying drift adjustments, preventing accidental backward jumps
Fixed auto-pause before song playback: Ensured active playback state broadcast upon track changes and buffer completion
Enhanced room reconnect & recreation: Robust 3-tier metadata fallback and complete state cache teardown on room disconnect
